hypotheses.link_congestion: Link congestion causing egress queue drops and added latency
hypotheses.weak_wifi: Weak Wi-Fi signal causing retransmissions and loss for wireless clients
hypotheses.interface_fault: Ethernet interface/cabling fault causing errors and packet loss
hypotheses.hardware_failure: Device hardware failure (interface errors, pegged CPU, severe loss)
hypotheses.device_overload: Device CPU/memory overload delaying forwarding and control plane
hypotheses.dns_failure: DNS service failure while the IP path is healthy
hypotheses.dhcp_failure: DHCP service failure preventing clients from obtaining addresses
hypotheses.upstream_issue: Problem upstream of the observed device (WAN/ISP/core path)

error_codes.E_SCHEMA_INVALID: Message or record does not match its JSON Schema (bad type, bad JSON, truncated).
error_codes.E_UNIT_UNKNOWN: A unit was given that cannot be converted to the canonical unit.
error_codes.E_FIELD_UNMAPPED: A field could not be mapped to the canonical vocabulary; it is kept under `unmapped`.
error_codes.E_MISSING_REQUIRED: A required field (e.g. device_id) is absent; the record is rejected.
error_codes.E_OUT_OF_RANGE: A value is physically impossible (e.g. percent > 100, negative latency).
error_codes.E_STALE_DATA: A record is older than the staleness window relative to the batch.
error_codes.E_AGENT_TIMEOUT: An agent did not answer a task or query before its deadline.
error_codes.E_UNSUPPORTED_VERSION: The message uses a protocol major version this receiver cannot migrate.
error_codes.E_UNKNOWN_DEVICE: The device_id is not present in the topology.
error_codes.E_INTERNAL: An agent raised an unexpected exception; it was contained and reported.

wifi_rssi_dbm.description: Received signal strength at the client/AP

queue_drops.description: Egress queue drops in the sample interval

interface_errors.description: Interface input/CRC errors in the sample interval

interface_flaps.description: Link up/down transitions in the sample interval

uptime_s.description: Device uptime (a drop indicates a reboot)

dns_success_pct.description: Share of DNS probe queries resolved

dhcp_success_pct.description: Share of DHCP lease attempts that succeeded

dhcp_pool_utilization_pct.description: Share of the DHCP pool leased
